name: facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_llm/perception/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.review_Perception_class: review the abstract Perception class and its detectors initialization pattern
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.refactor_Perception_initialize: refactor the Perception abstract class to add concrete initialization logic
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.build_Perception_subclass: build a concrete subclass of Perception that implements the abstract initialize method
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.test_Perception_subclass: test a concrete Perception subclass to verify detectors are stored correctly
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.summarize_Perception_class: summarize the Perception abstract base class and its role in the agent perception stack

facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.preprocess_agent_observations: preprocess simulator observations for each agent extracting camera intrinsics, depth, and panoptic masks
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.detect_objects_from_panoptic: detect objects in the agent field of view using panoptic sensor output and depth images
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.map_panoptic_handles_to_categories: map object sim handles from the panoptic image to their semantic category names
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.build_intrinsics_matrix: build a 3x3 camera intrinsics matrix from focal length and image center parameters
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.get_object_detections_non_privileged: get object detections with masks, locations, and camera info for non-privileged graph updates

facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.build_world_graph_from_sim: build a PerceptionSim instance from a RearrangeSim to construct a complete ground truth world graph with rooms, furniture, and objects
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.get_recent_subgraph: get a partial world graph subgraph containing only objects visible in the agent's current field of view
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.get_recent_graph: get the most recent complete ground truth world graph with updated object receptacle and agent room associations
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.initialize_partial_obs: initialize the world graph in partial observability mode returning only receptacles without objects for the agent
facebookresearch_partnr-planner/habitat_.update_object_receptacle_associations: update the ground truth graph to reflect which receptacle each object currently rests on after being moved
